nodes.title: Exact restricted-ROOT limit and current bound comparison
nodes.statement: On the odd-index Gaussian root family, restricted ROOT is equivalent to log R_k/(k log5)->1 and to e_k+g_k=o(k), where e_k=log(abs(u_k v_k)/rad(abs(u_k v_k))) and g_k=log(5^k/(2abs(u_k v_k))). Pasten Theorem1.4(2) yields log R_k >= c0(log k)^2/loglog k for sufficiently large odd k; this lower-bound scale is o(k).
external_imports: Classical imported theorem: Pasten arXiv2312.03566v1 Theorem1.4(2). This is an established unconditional input, not the open ROOT premise.

nodes.title: Integral-j height improvement excluded on the root test family
nodes.statement: For the Frey curve y^2=x(x-a_k)(x+b_k) of every odd-index Gaussian root, v_5(j)=-2k. Thus the integral-j hypothesis of Pasten arXiv2608.23559 Theorem1.6 fails on every member.
